summary: Honor media dry-run and bind registry dispatch action

delivery.outcome: Media dry-run returns an explicit planned result without browser/filesystem calls or recording state changes. Registry dispatch binds the selected action and rejects conflicting payload action without mutating caller input. Publish after required CI and independent review.
nonGoals: No browser lifecycle, supported-action, dependency, host service or production grant changes.

architecture.decision: Guard each public media action before effects; expose planned metadata only. Bind registry action via a copied payload and reject ambiguous mismatches before invoking its executor.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of exact implementation while preserving existing recordings.

commands: Real Playwright dry-run and recording tests
Managed governance and required Python CI
